rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Bounding
rules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

rules.name: Caster
rules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

rules.name: Deadly
rules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Fanatic
rules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

rules.name: Grounded Defense
rules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule has most of them within 1" of terrain, they get +1 to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Grounded Defense Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Grounded Defense. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Grounded Precision
rules.description: If most models in this unit are within 1" of terrain, this model gets +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

rules.name: Grounded Precision Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Grounded Precision. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Melee Slayer
rules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Melee Slayer Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Slayer. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Quick
rules.description: Moves +2" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

rules.name: Quick Shot
rules.description: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

rules.name: Quick Shot Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Quick Shot. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Re-Deployment
rules.description: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.

rules.name: Reap
rules.description: When attacking units that are Shaken or Fatigued, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 4-6.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Regeneration Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Repel Ambushers
rules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

rules.name: Slayer
rules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Spell Conduit
rules.description: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

rules.name: Surge
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Takedown
rules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

rules.name: Takedown Strike
rules.description: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

rules.name: Teleport
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Vanguard
rules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

spells.name: Bio-Displacer
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Teleport once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Brain Burst
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 2 hits with AP(2) and Deadly(3).

spells.name: Deep Hypnosis
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which must take a Morale Test. If failed you may move it by up to 6" in a straight line in any direction. Each unit may only be moved once per round in this way.

spells.name: Insidious Protection
spells.effect: Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Grounded Defense once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Mind Corruption
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger.

spells.name: Psychic Onslaught
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 3 hits with AP(1) and Reap. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger.
